mentions.name: Puddle Watercolor
mentions.description: A digital watercolor painting app that simulates real-world painting techniques by modeling the physics of paper, brush bristles, pigments, water, color mixing, and drying in real time on the GPU. Built in Rust with wgpu, it runs on iPad with Apple Pencil or finger input and is currently seeking beta testers.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I’m making a digital real watercolor kit.

I’m a software developer and watercolor painter so my goal is to use real world painting techniques and have the results feel and look real.

Modeling the physics of paper, brush bristles, pigments, water, color mixing, drying in real time using gpu.

Built in rust using wgpu.

Currently looking for iPad beta testers if anyone is interested (supports Apple Pencil or finger).

https://puddlewatercolor.com
mentions.author: bodhi_mind
